svg.text: Complete Inspection Lifecycle from Authentication to Report Delivery
Email verification via Resend API | Argon2 password hashing | HS256 signed cookies
Tenant-scoped: individual inspector sees own data, agency inspector sees company data (JWT decoded locally)
Record → Upload → Celery Queue → faster-whisper → transcription
Both flows write to media-service owned tables in shared PostgreSQL
Context for report generation (past reports, building codes)
ReportJob Status: QUEUED → PROCESSING → READY (pdf_url + verify_token) | or FAILED (error_message)
Report Sections: Executive Summary | Property Overview | Area-by-Area Findings | Severity Matrix | Photo Gallery | Recommendations
Inspector shares PDF with client → Client scans QR → Opens verification page → Confirms report authenticity
All data persisted in shared PostgreSQL 15 — Async tasks via Redis 7 + Celery workers
